build: Release isolated finance.shilling.perf; synthetic data; production UI and Store5/SQLite
notes: CPU milliseconds are process CPU across threads, not utilization.
CADisplayLink gaps are not rendering hitch durations.
Rendering-context intervals and inclusive stack categories overlap.
Baseline scroll resets change the resulting viewport; final runs preserve it.
Placeholder-only variant is intermediate; final also skips equal immutable snapshots.

manualUiChecks: Income filter retained after >7 seconds in Accounts
